title: Evidence Acceptance Policy
description: Defines the evidence hierarchy, acceptance criteria, and mandatory evidence requirements for Factory verifier verdicts. Establishes what constitutes valid, trustworthy evidence for PASS, FAIL, and CAVEAT outcomes.

evidenceHierarchy.description: Evidence types ordered by trustworthiness. Higher tiers can corroborate or override lower tiers. Lower tiers alone cannot override higher tiers.

tiers.label: Verifier JSON Result
tiers.description: Machine-readable JSON output from an automated verifier module. Must include verifierName, targetGate, outcome (PASS/FAIL), evidenceRefs, and timestamp.
tiers.format: JSON with required fields: verifierName, targetGate, outcome, evidenceRefs[], timestamp

tiers.label: Worker Completion Transcript
tiers.description: Full execution transcript from a worker agent session. Must be complete (not summarized, not compressed).
tiers.format: Plain text or structured log; must include agentId, phase, startTimestamp, endTimestamp
tiers.antiTamper: SHA256 hash of transcript must be recorded in evidence entry.

tiers.label: Agent Registry Entry
tiers.description: Entry in AGENT_REGISTRY.json recording agent spawn, completion, or termination.

tiers.label: Progress Event
tiers.description: Entry in AGENT_PROGRESS.jsonl recording a phase transition or milestone event.

tiers.label: Summary / Narrative
tiers.description: Human-readable summary or narrative description. Not accepted as primary evidence. Must be corroborated by tier 1-4 evidence.
restrictions: Cannot be sole evidence for any PASS verdict.
Cannot override a FAIL verdict from a higher tier.
Compressed summaries (after context compression) are explicitly prohibited as evidence.
Codex self-report summaries without independent verifier confirmation are prohibited.

PASS.description: Every PASS verdict must be backed by at least one verifier JSON result. No manual PASS-only verdicts.
PASS.exceptions: None. Manual PASS is always prohibited.

FAIL.description: Every FAIL verdict must reference a specific target gate and include the verifier result that detected the failure.
prohibited: Generic FAIL with no specific target gate.
FAIL_TARGET_NOT_TRIGGERED without a named target gate.
expectedClass-only FAIL (must name target gate and verifier).

CAVEAT.description: Caveats must reference either a verifier finding or a transcript excerpt showing the gap.

prohibitedEvidence.compressedSummary: Any summary produced after context compression. Rendered untrusted by context-compression-policy.
prohibitedEvidence.codexSelfReport: Codex capability claims not independently verified by a verifier module.
prohibitedEvidence.scoreComputedOutput: Any PASS/FAIL derived from a computed score rather than a binary verifier check (SCORING_SYSTEM_GATE).
prohibitedEvidence.rewrittenHistorical: Historical evidence from DRY19/DRY20/DRY23/P2/H17/DRY24 that has been rewritten or reinterpreted.
prohibitedEvidence.undeclaredFallback: Evidence of Main Agent fallback that was not declared in the agent spawn record.
prohibitedEvidence.manualOnlyVerdict: PASS, FAIL, or CAVEAT verdict without machine-readable verifier output or transcript backing.

evidenceChainRequirements.description: For a PASS verdict to be valid, the evidence chain must be complete: verifier result references evidence entries, which reference transcripts or progress events, which reference the artifacts they describe.
